scope: Desktop V3.8 independent synthetic demo data layer only

comparableBefore.note: Initial same 41-case formal snapshot ran against preserved pre-fix data source; initial test snapshot is demo-data-boundaries-initial.test.cjs. Later 3 sale-gate cases are recorded separately in saleGateCorrection; no historical external test/log changed.

originalBefore.note: Initial 34-case protection run before user clarified X01 and its 7 formal cases were added.

sharedInterfaces.loanBlockingQuantity: Count outstanding less unresolved transferred quantities; prefer transfers[], support legacy transfer{} and transferred boolean
sharedInterfaces.refreshOrder: Mutate summary and accepted/failure settling/pending_completion state only; preserve completed state, versions and event history

limits: Data-layer tests exercise actual D.apply/derive and immutable-input boundaries; actual app form/global-action coverage belongs to frontend agent/root.
No independent commission transfer contract exists in the current backend; unsettled commissions block completion even when arbitrary transferred=true is supplied.
Historic external D02/D03 full-cash repair expectations and D04 missing explicit flag are superseded by user-confirmed X01; they were not edited or counted as current-contract failures.
cleanup: No services, containers, keys, real data, index sync or temporary directories created by this agent; test state stays in terminating Node processes.

saleGateCorrection.authorizedBy: root authorized temporary unfreeze of only data.js and data-boundaries.test.cjs
guards: cash-sale quote total remains frozen payment threshold even when receivable is reduced or increased
cash-sale verified receipt/refund net amount below quote blocks, top-up restores permission
credit-sale existing prepay threshold remains unaffected by receivable adjustment and refunds
